_comment: Per-window-kind layout for TP messages. The kind is the fuki_kind byte
of each message's INF1 attributes (see window_kinds.py / TAGS.md).
warn_width / max_width are line width limits in font px; null means
'use the global plugin settings'. font_file picks the BFN font for the
kind (empty = default font). lines_per_page drives preview pagination
and the page-height scale. Explicit per-string overrides always win.
